observations: Photo 0: Two Xbox One controllers stacked on top of a console, textured vent panel visible on console side, sofa/couch backdrop.
Photo 1: Console shown from top with two controllers resting on left side, a power brick with cable visible above, 'XBOX' text faintly visible on brick.
Photo 2: Console, two controllers, and power brick laid out separately on a couch; 'XBOX' logo visible on the console's front face.
No HDMI cable visible in any photo.
No wall power cord (the cord from the brick appears to end in a short connector, not a full mains plug) visible.
No games, discs, or game cases visible in any photo despite seller's claim of '6 games'.
Console surface shows scuff marks, dust, and smudges consistent with heavy used condition.
No power-on, screen, or dashboard shot showing the unit actually functioning.

No discs, cases, or digital library screen shown in any photo
photo 0, 1, and 2 all show two controllers
Only power brick and a short cable segment visible; no HDMI cable or full mains cord shown

risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to dashboard screen

risks.risk: Missing HDMI cable needed to use the console
risks.proof: Photo showing HDMI cable included in the bundle
risks.if_unproven: priced as accessory missing, buyer must source separately

risks.risk: Claimed '6 games' may not actually be included or may be unlicensed/damaged discs
risks.proof: Photo of the 6 game cases/discs alongside the console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + controllers only, games excluded

risks.risk: Controllers may have connectivity or button issues not visible in static photos
risks.proof: Video clip showing both controllers connected and responsive in-game
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/worst case functional state

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and reaching the home dashboard
Photo of the 6 games (cases and discs) included in the sale
Photo of complete power cable (brick plus full cord to wall plug)
Photo or video confirming HDMI cable is included
Short clip of both controllers paired and functioning with the console
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One console with two controllers, but key claims (working condition, games included, full accessory set) are unverified from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case as console+controllers only, untested, with missing games and incomplete cabling until proof is supplied.
